task: Review this short APA 7 reading note and reference, returning them unchanged if they are sound. The supplied source is a stable, undated webpage without page numbers. Venue rules: use n.d.; a quotation may use the named section and paragraph number; do not invent pages or an access date. Reference format is Author. (n.d.). Italicized webpage title. Site name. URL. input:
Mire (n.d.) writes that “the second bell may have marked a repair visit” (“Repair Visits” section, para. 3). The word “may” matters: the page offers a possible explanation for the bell, not a timetable proving when repairs occurred. I would retain that qualification in a summary.

Mire, S. (n.d.). *A bell without a schedule*. Cobalt Yard Notes. https://example.org/cobalt-yard/bell
